about: Local corrections applied on top of OSM by scripts/build_resort.py. Rule: where OSM and the official resort data disagree, the official data wins; names follow the official panorama map. Evidence and decisions: docs/official-comparison.md.
officialSources: https://saint-lary.digisnow.app/map/1/fr (official panorama, image dated 2024-11-25) — names are taken from its labels

Rhodos.why: The panorama labels rhodos 1 above the Corniche 2 crossing and rhodos 2 below it; OSM has one way.

Arbizon 1.why: The panorama labels arbizon 1 above the Corniche 2 crossing and arbizon 2 below it; OSM names both 'Arbizon 1'.

1148860520.why: Tagged as a red Combes d'Aulon in OSM. Officially Combes d'Aulon is blue, but the panorama shows an unnamed red line beside the Aulon lift. Kept red, unnamed (decision Q1).

1029057252.why: 12 m start of Isard with no difficulty; Isard is red.
